app.title: Terra Incognita
app.tagline: Geography quiz games played on a world map.

map.playLabel: Map. Arrow keys move between places, Enter selects
map.statsLabel: Map. Arrow keys move between places, Enter opens details

daily.title: Daily challenge
daily.subtitle: 10 places, the same for everyone today
daily.line: Find 10 places on the world map. Everyone gets the same places today, and you get one attempt.

find.name: Landfall
find.subtitle: Find on the map
find.help: You're shown a place by its name, its flag or both, and tap it on the map. Right answers move on by themselves; after a wrong one the map shows the real place and you press Next. You get one try per place (three with Easy mode), and places you haven't reached when you end the round count as missed.

name.name: The Surveyor
name.subtitle: Name on the map
name.help: A place lights up on the map and you type its name on the keyboard below, in English or German. Small typos are forgiven, and if your answer could mean more than one place, keep typing. You get one try per place; “I don't know” shows you the answer and counts as missed.

capital.name: Ports of Call
capital.subtitle: Name the capital
capital.help: A place lights up on the map and is named, and you type its capital on the keyboard below, in English or German. If a place has several capitals, any of them counts. Small typos are forgiven, and if your answer could mean more than one capital, keep typing. You get one try per place; “I don't know” shows you the answer and counts as missed.

country.name: Sighting
country.subtitle: Name that country
country.help: A flag or a silhouette appears at the top and you type the name of its place on the keyboard below, in English or German. The map gives nothing away until you answer, then flies to the place. Small typos are forgiven; “I don't know” shows you the answer and counts as missed.

fill.name: Here Be Dragons
fill.subtitle: Fill the map
fill.help: Type the places of your chosen region and tier, in any order and in English or German, and each one you name fills in on the map. Typos are forgiven; a name that is wrong, already filled or not in this round just shakes, with no penalty. Naming a place also fills the land merged into it in this tier. The round ends when the map is full, the timer runs out or you end it, and your score is the places filled out of all of them. A round ended with End round doesn't count for your stats or bests.

missing.name: Atlantis
missing.subtitle: What's missing
missing.help: Ten places have been wiped off the map. Tap where you think each one belongs: a hit names the place, a tap on the wrong land shows which place you hit, and a tap on the sea is a miss. You have 10 taps (30 with Easy mode), and with Timed on, 90 seconds. The round ends when all ten are found, the taps run out or the time is up.

wayfinder.name: Wayfinder
wayfinder.subtitle: Shortest distance
wayfinder.help: Link the start and the target by typing the places in between, in any order, in English or German. As many places as the shortest route needs are free; each one beyond that costs one of your five detours, and the round ends when they're spent. Only borders on the mainland count: exclaves, overseas parts and islands don't link places.
